definition: Fraction of all 224 complete months with at least one contribution.
interpretation: Long-run contribution persistence.

definition: Number of complete months with at least one road-related OSM contribution.
interpretation: Total duration of observed contribution activity.

definition: Normalized Herfindahl-Hirschman concentration of contributions across active months.
interpretation: Zero approaches temporal dispersion; one means all contributions occur in a single active month; undefined when total contributions are zero.

definition: Total contributions divided by summed monthly contributor counts.
interpretation: Activity intensity per contributor-month; not per unique person over the whole period.

definition: Median absolute month-to-month change in contributor count normalized by mean contributor count in active months.
interpretation: Contributor-intensity volatility proxy; not identity-based contributor churn.

definition: Sum of monthly contributions classified as creation.
interpretation: Expansion-oriented contribution count; contribution-type filters may overlap.

definition: Creation-classified contributions relative to all contributions.
interpretation: Expansion-oriented frequency relative to all contributions; may coexist with other type classifications.

definition: Mapped road length in the final complete month.
interpretation: Current mapped-road state.

definition: Sum of monthly contributions classified as deletion.
interpretation: Deletion-oriented contribution count; contribution-type filters may overlap.

definition: Deletion-type event count relative to the sum of the four counted type-event totals.
interpretation: Share of counted type-events oriented to deletion. Together with expansion and maintenance proxies it sums to one when defined, but this is a type-event composition, not a unique-contribution composition.

definition: Deletion-classified contributions relative to all contributions.
interpretation: Deletion-oriented frequency relative to all contributions; may coexist with other type classifications.

definition: Creation-type event count relative to the sum of the four counted type-event totals.
interpretation: Share of counted type-events oriented to expansion. Denominator may double-count contributions with multiple type labels.

definition: First complete month in which mapped road length is greater than zero.
interpretation: Intrinsic onset of mapped-road presence; undefined for cells without roads.

definition: Sum of monthly contributions classified as geometry change.
interpretation: Geometry-maintenance contribution count; contribution-type filters may overlap.

definition: Geometry-change-classified contributions relative to all contributions.
interpretation: Geometry-maintenance frequency relative to all contributions; may coexist with other type classifications.

definition: Official 1 km grid-cell identifier.
interpretation: Spatial key; unique by cell.

definition: Difference between early post-onset and recent median growth rates.
interpretation: Positive values indicate slower recent growth than early post-onset growth.

definition: Growth deceleration normalized by the absolute early post-onset growth rate.
interpretation: Relative deceleration; undefined when early median growth is zero or unavailable.

definition: Median net monthly road-length change during the first 24 months after mapped-road onset, excluding the onset jump itself.
formula: median(Delta L_t), t in first 24 post-onset months
interpretation: Robust post-onset early growth rate; does not duplicate the initial mapping pulse captured by peak_growth_m.

definition: Median net monthly road-length change during the final 24 complete months.
formula: median(Delta L_t), t in final 24 months
interpretation: Robust recent net growth rate.

definition: Maximum mapped road length observed over the complete monthly series.
interpretation: Historical maximum mapped-road state.

definition: Mean contributions before the final 24 complete months.
interpretation: Earlier-period activity intensity.

definition: Longest run of consecutive months with at least one contribution.
interpretation: Maximum sustained activity spell.

definition: Longest run of consecutive months with zero contributions.
interpretation: Maximum inactivity spell.

definition: Tag-change plus geometry-change event counts relative to the sum of the four counted type-event totals.
interpretation: Share of counted type-events oriented to maintenance. Denominator may double-count multi-labelled contributions.

definition: Elapsed months from first mapped-road presence through the final complete month.
interpretation: Intrinsic mapping age; undefined for cells without roads.

definition: Mean road-related contributions per complete month.
interpretation: Average monthly activity including inactive months.

definition: Mean monthly number of unique contributors.
interpretation: Average contributor intensity including inactive months.

definition: Median road-related contributions per complete month.
interpretation: Robust typical monthly activity including inactive months.

definition: Median monthly number of unique contributors.
interpretation: Robust typical contributor intensity including inactive months.

definition: Months elapsed from first reaching 90% of the recent reference to the final complete month.
interpretation: Duration spent at or beyond the intrinsic 90% milestone, regardless of later fluctuations.

definition: Months from the last active month to the final complete month.
interpretation: Recency of contribution activity; undefined for cells with no contributions.

definition: Number of months with negative net road-length change.
interpretation: Frequency of net mapped-road contraction or deletion.

definition: Largest positive month-to-month road-length change.
interpretation: Magnitude of the largest observed expansion pulse; zero when no positive change occurs.

definition: Month of the largest positive month-to-month road-length change.
interpretation: Timing of the largest observed expansion pulse; undefined if no positive change is observed.

definition: Maximum road-related contributions in a single month.
interpretation: Largest monthly editing pulse.

definition: Maximum monthly number of unique contributors.
interpretation: Largest observed contributor pulse.

definition: Geometric mean of long-run and recent activity ratios.
interpretation: Transparent joint persistence indicator; equals zero if either component is zero.

definition: Months from detected plateau start through the final complete month.
interpretation: Duration of the descriptive plateau regime.

definition: First month at or after the 90% milestone starting a 12-month low-range window and satisfying the tail persistence rule.
formula: first t >= t_90 with range(L_{t:t+11}) <= max(50 m, 0.02*L_ref) and tail persistence >= 0.80
interpretation: Descriptive plateau onset; not proof of external completeness.

definition: Fraction of months from plateau start onward lying within the plateau tolerance around the recent reference.
interpretation: Tail stability conditional on a detected plateau; required to be at least 0.80.

definition: Number of months with positive net road-length change.
interpretation: Frequency of net mapped-road expansion.

definition: Fraction of months from detected plateau start onward with at least one contribution.
interpretation: Persistence of editing after descriptive plateau; undefined when no plateau is detected.

definition: Fraction of the final 24 complete months with at least one contribution.
interpretation: Recent contribution persistence.

definition: Mean contributions in the final 24 complete months.
interpretation: Recent activity intensity.

definition: Robust recent mapped-road reference based on the final 12 complete months.
interpretation: Intrinsic reference only; not external completeness.

definition: Recent mean monthly contributions divided by the earlier-period mean.
interpretation: Values above 1 indicate higher recent activity; undefined when historical mean is zero.

definition: Current road length relative to the recent 12-month median reference.
interpretation: Intrinsic convergence indicator; may exceed 1 after recent expansion and is undefined when the reference is zero.

definition: Sum of monthly contributions classified as tag change.
interpretation: Attribute-maintenance contribution count; contribution-type filters may overlap.

definition: Tag-change-classified contributions relative to all contributions.
interpretation: Attribute-maintenance frequency relative to all contributions; may coexist with other type classifications.

definition: Months from mapped-road onset to first reaching 50% of the recent reference.
interpretation: Intrinsic trajectory milestone; undefined for cells without a positive recent reference.

definition: Months from mapped-road onset to first reaching 80% of the recent reference.
interpretation: Intrinsic trajectory milestone; undefined for cells without a positive recent reference.

definition: Months from mapped-road onset to first reaching 90% of the recent reference.
interpretation: Intrinsic trajectory milestone used as the earliest possible plateau start.

definition: Months from mapped-road onset to first reaching 95% of the recent reference.
interpretation: Intrinsic trajectory milestone.

definition: Total road-related OSM contributions across all complete months.
interpretation: Whole-period activity intensity.

definition: Sum of monthly unique-contributor counts.
interpretation: Contributor-month exposure; not the number of unique contributors across the whole period.
